g.text: Note: Both sides are point observations reported on their own dates, so each ratio carries the gap between them - median 42 days, longest

g.text: 272. Divisional headcounts are excluded because a division's staff against company-wide revenue is not a ratio of anything. Revenue

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: is a run rate, so this is revenue per employee at an annualised rate, not booked revenue per employee.
